items.label: Lenovo Q1 FY2027 (08-13-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Memory and component supply (CEO Yuanqing Yang): 'we believe demand for memory

set.signal: Memory and component supply (CEO Yuanqing Yang): 'we believe demand for memory will continue to rise for a considerable period ahead, at least by the end of next year. That means that the supply will be still constrained.' He said he believes Lenovo is now among the top customers of the major semiconductor suppliers, that Lenovo sources from suppliers in the U.S., Korea and China ('we definitely cannot ignore the China supply'), and that it can adjust front-end pricing in a timely manner when material costs rise. IDG President Luca Rossi: an inflationary cost environment, 'particularly in certain commodity memory, but memory is not the only one'.

items.reason: Hedge restored: the CEO prefaced the top-customer claim with 'I believe'; the entry stated it as a fact.
items.evidence: I believe Lenovo is now among the top customers of the major semiconductor suppliers.
